description_expanded:
Gated Seashore Village, in Seagrove

Just steps to private beach access!

Private pool!

Complimentary (seasonal) beach chairs and umbrella!

4 bikes! Explore Seaside, WaterColor, Alys, and Rosemary Beach.

Walk to 5-star restaurants, boutiques, Eastern Lake, Deer Lake State Park

Three porches!

Charcoal grill

5 Bedrooms, 3.5 Bathrooms

Primary bedroom with private balcony on third floor

2 parking spaces with carport

Bluesunshine by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Say hello to Bluesunshine, a happy little slice of Seagrove just a few sandy steps from the beach and moments from Eastern Lake. Everything feels easier here. Stretch out by the private pool(!), wander to the porches for Gulf views, and let the week unfold. Complimentary beach chairs and umbrella?

Whoa! From March 1 through October 31, we’ve got you covered (with shade). Your private pool waits out back, perfect for cannonballs, quiet floats, or pretending you’re in a travel commercial. Four bikes are ready too. Ride to Seaside for breakfast, to Alys Beach for pics that make your friends jealous, or to Rosemary Beach for, well, anything delicious. Inside, five bedrooms and three-and-a-half baths keep everyone comfy. The second-floor living space opens onto a balcony with two bed swings, which have been known to steal entire afternoons. Exterior stairs lead straight to the pool deck for quick dips or snack refills. The third-floor primary suite gets its own balcony, the kind of hideaway that pairs well with coffee, sunsets, or escaping group decisions about dinner. And because Bluesunshine sits on Seashore Circle, a quiet, one-way street, kids can roam a bit and grownups can relax a lot. Add in two covered parking spaces, a charcoal grill, and walkability to 5-star restaurants and boutiques, and your vacation basically plans itself. As always, the Oversee 30A team is nearby, making sure everything feels just right. Need anything? We’re here every day, plus a 24/7 line for the unexpected. Now go enjoy that pool. Overview: -Gated Seashore Village, in Seagrove -2,415 sq ft -Private beach access - Complimentary beach chairs and an umbrella (March 1st - October 31st) -Private pool -4 complimentary bikes -Quick walk to restaurants and bike paths -Wi-Fi -Charcoal grill -Private off-street gated parking for 2 (carport) Overnight: FIRST FLOOR Guest Room: Queen bed, shared full hall bath Bunk Room: Full-over-full bunks, shared full hall bath Guest Room: Queen bed, connected full hall bath SECOND FLOOR Bunk Room: Twin bunks, shared half hallway bath THIRD FLOOR Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, balcony Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST
